person.name: Mohammed Pathariya
person.headline: AI Engineer building agentic AI systems and LLM pipelines, from multi-agent orchestration to HPC-scale NLP.
person.tagline: I build agentic AI systems and LLM pipelines, from multi-agent orchestration to HPC-scale NLP.
person.summary: An AI Engineer and MS in Data Science candidate at Indiana University Bloomington specializing in agentic AI systems, LLM pipelines, and HPC-scale NLP. Builds production-grade multi-agent systems, RAG pipelines, and transformer-based predictive models.

projects.title: The Digital Forge
projects.description: A sequential multi-agent code generation system using CrewAI to mimic the software development lifecycle across four specialized agents. Features a self-healing Docker sandbox and a ChromaDB RAG guardrail grounding agents in verified API references.
metrics: 80% final pass rate on a 20-task benchmark versus a 45% zero-shot GPT-4 baseline
25% task recovery through the self-healing Docker sandbox
15% hallucination rescue through the ChromaDB RAG guardrail

projects.title: LearnLoop
projects.description: A fault-tolerant RAG-based study tool with session-scoped FAISS indexes for strict data isolation and a Pydantic self-healing validation layer.
metrics: Autonomously corrects 90% of LLM JSON schema hallucinations
Reduced user-facing LLM errors from approximately 10% to under 1%
SQLite WAL mode sustained 500+ concurrent users with zero HTTP 500 errors

projects.title: AudioGroove
projects.description: A comparative deep learning research study scaling symbolic music generation to 175,000+ MIDI files. Built a distributed Dask ETL pipeline and demonstrated that Bi-Directional LSTMs outperform DCGANs for symbolic music generation.
metrics: Reduced distributed MIDI processing from 20+ hours to under 2 hours
Achieved 0.78 cross-entropy loss versus a 4.8 random baseline

projects.title: HandSpeak
projects.description: Engineered a low-latency sign language recognition system. Extracted vector landmarks with MediaPipe and classified them with Scikit-Learn Random Forest models to achieve 30+ FPS CPU inference without heavy GPUs.

projects.title: CodeCrafter
projects.description: Architected a secure remote code execution engine that runs user-submitted Python and R code inside ephemeral, network-isolated Docker containers before rendering visualizations.

projects.title: Automated Snake Game
projects.description: Trained a Deep Q-Network agent to master Snake from pixel inputs using Experience Replay and Epsilon-Greedy exploration to stabilize convergence on optimal pathfinding policies.

projects.title: VAYU – Air Quality Forecasting
projects.description: Developed a time-series forecasting pipeline for PM2.5 levels, managing the lifecycle from cleaning OpenAQ sensor data to training LSTM sequence models for temporal predictive accuracy.

projects.title: BloomMap
projects.description: Built an interactive geospatial dashboard for public facilities using GeoPandas coordinate clustering and a React/Flask container to visualize service coverage heatmaps.

projects.title: Content Detection
projects.description: Benchmarked spam classification architectures by comparing Sequential LSTMs with Feed-Forward Networks and implementing an NLP preprocessing pipeline with lemmatization and vectorization.

projects.title: Yudishthir Desktop Assistant
projects.description: Developed a voice-controlled operating system automation agent using SpeechRecognition APIs and system-level scripting for file management, surveillance, and information retrieval tasks.

experience.title: Graduate Research Assistant
experience.organization: Indiana University Luddy School of Informatics, Computing, and Engineering
points: Built a complete alignment-free diagnostic pipeline on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, replacing Minimap2 alignment with a custom k-mer voting classifier achieving under 1 second per sample on CPU versus 10-20 minutes with traditional tools.
Validated against 43,000+ clinical sequences from Stanford HIVdb across 10+ HIV subtypes globally, achieving 97.5-99.7% recall with all per-mutation Fisher exact tests significant at p < 0.001.

Engineered a six-component Python preprocessing suite handling FASTQ/FASTA parsing, codon frame resolution via stop-codon counting, and gene region localization across PR/RT/IN with automated quality filtering.

Designed a CNN-Transformer architecture for resistance classification targeting TensorRT quantization for Jetson deployment, with training data prepared across 16 ACTG clinical trials and 8,000+ sequences.

experience.title: Graduate Research Assistant
experience.organization: Indiana University Kelley School of Business
points: Built an end-to-end NBA press conference pipeline processing 700+ games, parallelizing WhisperX transcription across 5 Slurm-managed HPC nodes with SQLite file-locking for distributed state, achieving a 30x speedup from 3.5m to 7s per audio-minute.

Deployed 8-bit quantized Llama-3 8B with bitsandbytes on Big Red 200 A100 nodes for psychological marker extraction, achieving 89% precision, a 17-point improvement over a 72% RoBERTa baseline on a 500-quote gold set.

Architected a Transformer Encoder fusing Llama-3 sentiment embeddings with rolling box-score metrics, chosen over XGBoost to allow direct feature interaction, achieving 53.8% Against-The-Spread accuracy on a 120-game chronological holdout versus 52.4% breakeven.

experience.title: Data Engineering Intern
points: Collaborated with a senior engineer to conduct root-cause analysis on a 5% KPI discrepancy between Marketing and Finance, resolving it via a SQL View as a shared source of truth, an architectural fix rather than a query patch.

Diagnosed a legacy PostgreSQL sales report taking 5 minutes to generate, identified the root cause via execution plan analysis, and implemented composite indexing reducing report generation latency by 40% from 5m to 3m.

Diagnosed recurring database lock contention in production Airflow ETL pipelines, implementing automated retry logic that reduced nightly pipeline failures by 90%, from near-daily incidents to under one manual intervention per month.
